text: If you get back together with your ex, you should suffer. Let's go to a story where the guy learned it hard way. Hi Ilyas, I'm currently in a difficult situation with my girlfriend. We had been together for 8 months when I broke up with her, because she hid the fact that she hanged out with a male friend while we were briefly separated. When we started talking again... Okay, she did something you didn't like and you broke up with her. Good, but why the hell you started talking again? Guys, once again, you make dumb decisions, you get painful consequences. That's how the life works. If you get back together with your ex, you should suffer. Why are you talking again? Why she's not blocked everywhere? She called you, but you answered. It means you wanted it to start again. When we started talking again, she called me for my birthday. I asked if she had seen anyone during those weeks. She said no. When I found out the truth from a friend, I broke up with her again and we didn't speak for 3 months. Sure, broke up again and the story continues. How many times should you break up in order to you to start having self-respect and self-love not to go back to your ex? During that time, she had 2 brief flings that lasted about a week each. Just kissing, nothing serious. How do you know that it was just kissing? That's one thing. And second thing, how do you know about these flings? From her, from friends? So you've been actually following her, asking questions. And I guess you also believe it was just kissing. Why do you believe it was just kissing and nothing serious? Probably because she told you that. After 3 months of her trying to reach out, I finally replied to an Instagram message where she said she missed me. 3 months, tough as a rock. Man, even Superman has its own kryptonite. She mentioned it would have been our 1-year anniversary if it hadn't been for her mistake. We met the next day and things happened between us. However, 2 days later, she admitted that 2 weeks before messaging me, she had done more than just kiss a guy she used to be interested in years ago. Yeah, now let's go back to those other guys that she had a fling with and was just kissing. Do you believe she was just kissing with them or there was something else? She said she did it because she never thought we'd get back together. Now she's quitting smoking for me and changing her lifestyle, going to the gym, being kinder and more attentive. But I can't get that thought out of my head since she told me a couple of days ago I've had a constant nod in my stomach. Thank you for your time and I hope you can help. Again, you get back with your ex, you should suffer. Every time you do it, your self-respect goes down and down if there's any left. Guys, don't get back with your exes. People almost never change, so the problems you had before will not magically go away. If you want to grow as a man, if you want to have strong principles, the best thing you can do is move on. Block your ex everywhere. Even if you broke up on good terms, you can tell her, look, it's nothing personal, but it would be much easier for me and you to move on if we cannot reach out to each other, if we cannot communicate. Then you start going on dates and seeing other women, working on your career, hobbies, sports, and life in general. It is the wisdom that was tested by millions other men who tried and failed getting back together with an ex. Just remember it, if you get back together with an ex, you should suffer.
